Inter's papers made 14 claims this week and the club confirmed 4. Corriere dello Sport said the three English signings had given Chivu almost nothing — then Djed Spence took UEFA's player of the match at De Kuip and an England call-up. Gazzetta dello Sport had him at right back and got that one right. data/youtube-ed68.json.description:
Inter's papers made 14 claims this week. The club confirmed 4, two were flat wrong, eight are still open.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=68

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

DENIED — Corriere dello Sport (Nov 3): the three English signings have given Chivu almost nothing. Spence then took UEFA's player of the match at De Kuip and an England call-up.
CONFIRMED — Gazzetta dello Sport (Nov 3): Chivu keeps Spence at right back at De Kuip. He started and set up Bisseck's opener.
CONFIRMED — Italpress (Nov 4): Chiffi is appointed for Inter against Como. Inter.it confirmed it on Nov 6.
CONFIRMED — Tuttosport (Nov 2): Pavard is back with the group. He came on in the 85th minute at De Kuip.
CONFIRMED — Gazzetta dello Sport (Nov 5): Jones and Stones are back in training. The club's own session pictures showed both on the field.
STILL OPEN — Sportmediaset (Nov 7), Sky Sport Italia (Nov 6) and Gazzetta dello Sport (Nov 8) disagree on who starts at left back against Como.

Read today's edition: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/p/edition-68/
